description: Synthetic protocol records for local Protocol Atlas development. These are not validated laboratory instructions.

chunks.text: Add 500 microliters of lysis buffer to the sample tube and vortex for 30 seconds. Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 2 minutes. Carefully transfer the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 200 microliters of wash buffer, mix by gentle inversion, and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 1 minute.
Wear gloves and work on a clean surface. Label all tubes before beginning the extraction workflow.
Mix the lysate with an equal volume of ethanol before loading the mixture onto the spin column.
Wash the column twice with 500 microliters of wash solution, then centrifuge for 2 minutes to dry the membrane.
Elute RNA with 50 microliters of nuclease-free water and incubate for 1 minute before centrifuging.
Inspect cultures under the microscope before feeding. Record confluence, morphology, and any visible contamination.
Warm complete medium to room temperature. Aspirate spent medium and add fresh medium slowly along the vessel wall.
When cultures reach approximately 80 percent confluence, detach cells using the approved dissociation reagent and reseed at the planned density.
